  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or low (≤0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if recent history shows persistent underestimation of upward trends.",
    "Cap upward forecasts after spikes (e.g., >75% above recent mean) to prevent overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates >1.5σ from 30-day moving average, revert toward mean.",
    "Boost forecast sensitivity to sentiment spikes (e.g., >0.67) by scaling forecast adjustment by sentiment magnitude.",
    "Reduce forecast volatility when sentiment is flat (0.00–0.20) to avoid noise amplification.",
    "Offset downward bias in early periods (e.g., first 5 days) by adding 0.5–1.0% upward adjustment to compensate for lag."
  ]
